title: Platform Engineer - Globex
text:
Platform Engineer
Globex - Austin, TX (Hybrid)

Globex is hiring a Platform Engineer to build the internal developer platform used by 300 engineers. You will own CI/CD, Kubernetes tooling, and developer experience.

Requirements
- 5+ years in platform, infra, or SRE roles
- Terraform, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions
- Strong Python or Go

Base range: $160,000 - $195,000.
